heroDiscard.name: Fighter
heroDiscard.description: Boden the Pantless Boden's courage is matched only by his forgetfullness. The quest to find his misplaced armor continues!
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Thief
heroDiscard.description: Joman Chimm, Cutpurse From the twinkle in his eye, you might think he comes bearing gifts... until you check your empty pockets.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Mage
heroDiscard.description: Tieg and the Magic Bubble Armed with his trusty bubble, Tieg braves dangerous castles and dungeons in search of the muscial instruments stolen from his people.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Thief
heroDiscard.description: Sir Digby Apple, Ace Detective He battles to keep the coffers filling, to keep his partners preening and to send a needless message of power to all of the unwilling.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Thief
heroDiscard.description: Jesta the Rogue "Okay, so you take the big guy on the left with the axe, you've got the two little ones on the right with swords, and I'll take this dangerous-looking treasure chest with no lock over here..."
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Fighter
heroDiscard.description: Fire's Breath, Heroine of Arcadia The scarlet-haired warrior woman known as Fire's Breath has pledged her deadly twin blades to the fight for liberty
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Cleric
heroDiscard.description: Acacia, Warrior of Light Acacia is a carefree soul who makes her own luck. A strong defender of good, she is undeterred by even the darkest dungeons.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Mage
heroDiscard.description: Mitchell, the Judge He has wandered the planes, hopelessly lost... ever since his wife, Nikki, sent him to the store for diamond dust sugar.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Fighter
heroDiscard.description: Johnny of the Evening Watch A humble member of the Evening Watch, whose band o'brothers is sworn to forsake family, take the grey, and clear dungeons.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: Mage
heroDiscard.description: Dartteon, Elf Pyromancer Some elves just want to watch the world burn.
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroDiscard.name: The Fool
heroDiscard.description: The Fool is lured to the dungeon of the Boss Monster with the fewest Souls. (In the case of a tie, he waits in town until the tie is broken.)
heroDiscard.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

town.name: Cleric
town.description: Nick the Masher The young cleric was well-armed, and brave enough to take on the Dragon King himself. His credo: "I bash it with my mace."
town.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

town.name: Thief
town.description: Cecil Leoran, Master Factotum The ultimate jack-of-all-trades, Cecil isn't above taking mercenary work to earn gold and glory. But his real goal has never changed: to find a way to return his betrothed Nevra, sealed into a rapier, to her original form.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Mage
town.description: Tempros the Time Marauder He would use his control over time to end all crime. In his hands, this world could be a utopia.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Mage
town.description: Antonius, the Rune Knight An elite dragoon, Sir Tony wears armor inscribed with magic runes of ancient and mysterious power.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Fighter
town.description: Frankov, the Envoy This brave warrior stands alone against the evil that rules the world.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Thief
town.description: Terric Warhelm, Half-Elf Archmage "Weakened by an evil curse, this once-mighty warrior donned the red robes and turned to magic. His spells are chnneled through a magical helmet of untold power."
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Thief
town.description: Hya, Legendary Shinobi Arcadia's deadliest ninja,Hya lives by the proverb that revenge is a dish best served cold.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Cleric
town.description: Lord Van Ette A prophet and collector of tithes for the omniscient Celestial, his "miracles" are enhanced by the brandewijn distilled by the monks of Nintehn.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero

town.name: Cleric
town.description: Katelyn, Angelic Healer Among the most exalted defenders of righteousness, Katelyn is sometimes referred to as "altissima luce" -- highest light.
town.subtitle: Epic Hero
